summary: Implemented the window title setting without running tests, mypy, or Black. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title() gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200 (URL built from the number, not verified). Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing committed. All verification was by reading the code.
